general.title: Everyday questions and chat
general.about: Default for anything that doesn't match a sharper job.

strategy.title: Strategy, plans and decisions
strategy.about: Business strategy, operations, go-to-market, prioritization and hard trade-offs.

business.title: Business, finance and analysis
business.about: Financial analysis, accounting, economics, reports and professional deliverables.

legal.title: Legal and compliance
legal.about: Contracts, terms, policies, regulation. Accuracy matters more than style.

health.title: Health and medical
health.about: Medical questions, clinical writing, health content. Always check with a professional.

research.title: Research and facts
research.about: Answers that must be true, and research with search.

long-context.title: Long documents and big codebases
long-context.about: Reading and reasoning across very long inputs. Needs a 200k+ window.

writing.title: Writing, copy and voice
writing.about: Articles, emails, ad copy, scripts, anything people read.

personality.title: Personality and conversation
personality.about: Assistants, coaching and customer chats: how it feels to talk to over many turns.

extraction.title: Following instructions and structured output
extraction.about: JSON, forms, data extraction and strict formats, usually at volume.

code-agent.title: Autonomous coding agents
code-agent.about: Long runs in a terminal or IDE agent: plan, edit many files, run tests, recover from errors. Agent benchmarks lag new releases, so current boards carry the most weight.

code-review.title: Code review and debugging
code-review.about: Finding the bug, reviewing a diff, root-causing. Rewards depth and honesty.

frontend.title: Websites, UI and screenshot-to-code
frontend.about: Landing pages and components, including rebuilding a design or section from a screenshot.

agentic.title: Tool use and multi-step agents
agentic.about: Agents that call tools and APIs, browse, and keep state across many steps.

image-text.title: Ads, posters and images with text
image-text.about: Designs where the words inside the image must come out right: ads, posters, thumbnails.

image-edit.title: Image editing
image-edit.about: Change an existing image: swap the background, fix details, keep the product or face identical.

voice.title: Voiceover and text-to-speech
voice.about: Needs the opt-in Artificial Analysis source (personal builds): no open voice leaderboard exists yet.

transcription.title: Transcription and speech-to-text
transcription.about: Needs the opt-in Artificial Analysis source (personal builds).

bulk.title: Bulk work at the lowest price
bulk.about: Thousands of summaries, classifications, rewrites. Intelligence per dollar.

fast.title: Instant answers (lowest latency)
fast.about: Needs speed data, which comes from the opt-in Artificial Analysis source (personal builds).
